KEY FACTS

Amazon Xtreme Fishing offers Rio Negro peacock-bass programs using both fixed accommodation and moving mothership formats. Its public offering says fishing gear can be supplied, so personal tackle purchases should depend on the exact package.

SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

This guide does not assign one low-water month to the entire Amazon. Ask for the operating area and the operator’s assessment for the selected week. A calendar for a different tributary should not be silently substituted for the Rio Negro.

Compare the fishing base

Ask how a fixed lodge and a moving base change daily travel and access to the intended fishing area. Compare usable fishing time, boat arrangements and transfers rather than accommodation photographs alone. A remote journey also needs a clear baggage allowance and a stated contingency for a missed connection; do not assume every transfer can be rescheduled independently.

Match tackle to sustained casting

Describe you’s preferred method and tolerance for repeated casting and lure work. Have the guide name the exact lure weights, hook and split-ring requirements, leader arrangement and useful alternatives. A few approved robust combinations are more practical than a large assortment of unverified lures. Do not infer a fish’s scientific identity or maximum size from the generic label “peacock bass.”

Separate personal kit from supplied tackle

Get the equipment inventory in writing for the actual departure. Confirm whether rods, reels, lures and replacements are all covered or only some of them. Keep bag weight focused on what is not supplied, accessible rain protection and dry storage. Treat operator claims about easy catches or insect conditions as marketing, not guaranteed trip facts.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Brazil

Recreational anglers generally need a federal licence, including foreign visitors. Some states also require a local licence, and protected waters can have extra restrictions.

  • 1 yearBRL 20
  • 1 yearBRL 60
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Amazonas recreational angler licence ↗
    Visitors who fish in Amazonas state. Request the state licence through IPAAM; the outfitter can coordinate the application.

Rules for this water

  • Use an operator with the required IPAAM fishing registration and lodge operating approval.
  • Recreational anglers must release all peacock bass in Amazonas.
